issues.problem: asin(R[2,0]) is not roll. It is the tilt of image-right out of the horizontal plane, and it equals roll only when the optical axis is horizontal. On the LIBERO agentview it equals asin(0.849*sin(roll)).
issues.evidence: Output of rotation_check.py (column cam_x_tilt): roll 30 -> 25.1 deg, roll 60 -> 47.3 deg, roll 89 -> 58.1 deg. World-up in camera coordinates is R[2,:], so the roll about the viewing axis is atan2(R[2,0], R[2,1]).
issues.fix: "Record roll_deg = degrees(atan2(R[2,0], R[2,1])) (null when the view is vertical); optionally also image_right_tilt_deg = degrees(asin(R[2,0]))." Apply the same change to preparation.view_frame in A5.

issues.plan_item: A1 documented scope / V0.1 synthetic expectations
issues.problem: "Exact for any camera position / yaw / elevation" was measured at one anchor pixel near the image's centre column, and even there behind_err was 0.4-0.5 deg, not 0. At off-centre anchors the global 'away' direction differs from the local image-up direction even with zero roll. The roll error is also understated: it reaches about 23 deg, not 20. A2's "farther from/nearer to that camera" is the radial direction, which is not A1's global forward.
issues.evidence: finalcheck/refs/local_vs_global.py on the real agentview: right error is 0.0 deg everywhere; behind error is 7.4 deg at the pudding pixel, 9.7 deg at the mug pixel and about 17 deg at u=40/480. rotation_check.py: roll 30 -> right_err 19.2 deg, roll 60 -> 22.8 deg. The relayout mug's bearing from the camera is 13.9 deg.
issues.fix: "Scope: left/right are exact at zero roll. behind/front use the camera's horizontal forward, which matches LIBERO's BDDL ±x exactly; the local image-up direction at off-centre anchors deviates by up to about 17 deg on the agentview, but the four words stay correct. Under roll, words stay correct up to 89 deg and the vector error reaches about 23 deg (roll 60)." In V0.1, use global camera-forward as the synthetic truth (or centre-column anchors), and assert words rather than 0-deg vectors off-centre. Optionally word A2's behind as "toward the top of image 1 along the support (the camera's viewing direction)".
